Name: Yri's Modular Flowers
Author: YriKururu
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/49kuYFZ.png[/img][/size]
[size=3]Yri's Modular Flowers allows you to change every static flower ingame individually for every season. 

It also adds new Digspots, Waterlilies and a "changeable tile"

It's highly customizable so you can simply turn all unwanted features off.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nwyY4OH.png[/img]
﻿
[u]Config Options:[/u]
  
Digspots:
Adds 5 digspot textures
 
 WaterLilies:
Adds 3 different types of waterlilies with 4 colors each

WildFlowers:
Choose between 43 different textures.
Adds 11 Yellog styled flowers and 8 different Vanilla styled flowers (vanilla style comes with 4 color options each)   
        
Changeable tiles:
The "changeable tiles" option adds an overlay to one of the vanilla tiles allowing you to add one more  flower to the maps. 

[u]Fully Compatible with:[/u]
Everything! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Po0Qyyz.png[/img]﻿
